'''Sergey Yurievich Solovyov''' ({{langx|ru|Серге́й Ю́рьевич Соловьёв}}; 3 February 1955 – 22 September 2023) was a Russian mathematician who was a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].{{sfn|Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics|2010|p=413}}

==Life and career==
Solovyov graduated from the faculty [[MSU CMC]] (1977).

Solovyov defended the thesis "Mathematical methods and principles of building automated knowledge engineering systems" for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1996).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://search.rsl.ru/ru/record/01000049825 |title=Mathematical methods and principles of building automated knowledge engineering systems |last=Solovyov |first=Sergey |date=1996 |website=[[Russian State Library]] |publisher= |access-date=14 June 2018 |ref=thesis|language=ru}}</ref>

Solovyov was awarded the title of [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]] (2003).

His area of scientific interests was information systems. He was a Project Manager for [http://www.glossary.ru Glossary].{{sfn|Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics|2010|p=414}} He wrote more than 70 scientific works on formal grammars, expert systems, experimental data processing systems and network technologies.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/glossary/ Scientific works of Sergey Solovyov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=73084&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Sergey Solovyov]</ref>

Sergey Solovyov died on 22 September 2023, at the age of 68.<ref>[https://cs.msu.ru/news/3956 Соловьев Сергей Юрьевич (3.02.1955-22.09.2023)] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>
